PockPock Agent 0.2.4 makes the local agent smarter with the tools it already has: it now retrieves the right tools instead of showing the model all of them, and it can break a job into a validated sequence of small steps instead of one long run.

## Download

| Your computer | Download |
|---|---|
| Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit) | [PockPock-Agent-Setup.exe](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/releases/latest/download/PockPock-Agent-Setup.exe) |
| Mac with Apple silicon (M1 or newer) | [PockPock-Agent-mac-arm64.dmg](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/releases/latest/download/PockPock-Agent-mac-arm64.dmg) |
| Mac with an Intel processor | [PockPock-Agent-mac-x64.dmg](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/releases/latest/download/PockPock-Agent-mac-x64.dmg) |

**Already using 0.2.3 on Windows?** PockPock updates itself: press **Restart to update** when it appears, or check in **Settings → Updates**. On a Mac, download and install it once, the same way as the first time. Your chats, settings and models are kept.

**New to PockPock?** Open the downloaded file, then press **Set up PockPock**; setup installs everything else. Windows may show **"Windows protected your PC"** because PockPock is not code-signed yet: press **More info**, then **Run anyway**. On a Mac, see the [installation guide](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/wiki/Installation).

## What's new since 0.2.3

- **Tool retrieval (Tool-RAG).** Before the model is asked to act, PockPock now retrieves the handful of tools the request actually needs instead of listing every tool schema in the prompt. On 97 real requests the right tool was in the top 5 in 99.2% of cases, and the tool schemas sent per turn fell by about a third. Tools that need full access stay invisible to default runs, and the model can search for more tools mid-task if the first set is not enough.
- **Small models answer again.** The gateway now tells Qwen 3.5 models to stop thinking for chat and tool calls, so replies that used to come back empty now come back. The default router model is now qwen3.5:2b instead of qwen2.5:1.5b, which was not installed.
- **Simple tasks use the small model.** Greetings and short factual questions route to the small model; reasoning, code and agent work keep the larger one. Ollama requests now keep models loaded longer and use a larger context window.
- **Plan-and-sequence.** The agent can now plan a job as a validated sequence of 5–15 small steps, each with its own tools, budget and a check for when it is done, then run one step at a time. Between steps a code-first verifier checks the result, and only a short state capsule (under 400 tokens) passes forward instead of the whole history. The planner is Qwen3.6-35B-A3B and the executor Qwen3.5-9B on a machine that can run them; OpenClaw can run the steps too, in subtask mode.
- **Groundwork for an agent that learns (off by default).** Three new developer pieces: an evaluation harness that scores the agent on a fixed set of 21 tasks; a skill and reasoning memory that turns finished runs into reusable skills, which are used only after they pass a check or you approve them; and an external verifier with a durable step ledger, so a run can be checked step by step and resumed after a crash. None of it changes how the app behaves unless you switch it on (`POCKPOCK_SKILLS_ENABLED`).
- **Docs.** The wiki and in-app help now have screenshots and sections for reports, Maintenance, Cloud models and Connectors.

## Good to know

- Plan-and-sequence is new: the step prompts and state capsule were measured inside their design targets, but a full plan-to-run round trip with real models has not been verified on a machine without a GPU, and the planner's 110-second timeout can still stop a plan before it starts.
- Tool retrieval's dense (embedding) path is wired but untested live, because the embedding model could not be downloaded here; retrieval falls back to keywords when embeddings are unavailable.
- The experiment scripts for FreeToken, speculative decoding and MoE expert offloading are in `docs/experiments/` for a machine with a GPU; they are not part of the app.
- Help, screenshots and example prompts are in the [wiki](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/wiki).
- Please [report problems](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/issues/new/choose).
